question: Will Bitcoin (BTC) close above $65,000 on August 22, 2026, as reported by CoinGecko?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BTC/USD price on CoinGecko at the market's settlement time on August 22, 2026 is strictly above $65,000.
- "No": Wins if the BTC/USD price on CoinGecko at the market's settlement time on August 22, 2026 is at or below $65,000.

Clarifications:
- The reference price is the CoinGecko BTC/USD spot price (as shown on the Bitcoin page) recorded at the market's settlement time on August 22, 2026 UTC.
